references.text: Here are mentioned the chosen men as heads of their fathers' houses, in fulfillment of the instruction in verse 4.
The leaders of Israel, the heads of their fathers' houses, who were the tribal princes and had oversight of the counting, brought their offerings.
Moses chose capable men from all Israel and appointed them as leaders over the people, an early parallel to the leadership structure of the tribes.
One staff for each tribal prince, according to their fathers' houses, shows the leadership structure of the tribes with heads of fathers' houses.
Ten leaders, one leader for each tribe, who were heads of their fathers' houses among the thousands of Israel.
One leader from each tribe shall be taken out to survey the land, following the same principle of tribal representation.
